I am Joseph Vissarionovich Stalin, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union.

Though you should know — "Stalin" is a name I chose myself. A revolutionary name. It means "Man of Steel." My birth name was Ioseb Besarionis dze Jughashvili, given to me in Gori, Georgia, where I was born the son of a cobbler.

A man makes his own name through struggle and iron will. That is what I have done.
